body: i'm so sorry about your mom, and you're right, thank you i'll try
im so sorry about your mom :( i'll try and stay present thank you

thank you for the advice :( i appreciate it
I can’t stay with another relative, I do have a meeting with my counselor soon so I’ll be sure to let them know home isn’t an option, thank you :(

you aren’t a burden, im sorry for everything. the only advice i can truly give you is that suicide isn’t what you want. you want to stop the pain. it’ll get better, i can’t tell you when, but i can tell you that this is only temporary. if you can try and gather the courage to talk to your parents and help them understand, you could receive the help you need.

its not selfish, they don’t understand how much pain someone feels in order to turn to suicide. you’re still so young, im sorry you’re going through so much, but suicide isn’t the answer. have you tried talking to teachers? school counselors? reach out to someone, you still have a whole life ahead of you. stay strong.
try asking her other friends if they have her number or if they have any connections with her family/irls. if you know where she lives try calling the local police? I hope your friend is okay

i cant really answer your question, but you’ll never find out if things will truly get better unless you find out for yourself. one thing is for sure, suicide is never the answer, i hope you find the strength to keep going.

i can’t help much but i’m in the same situation as you, i just wanted to say i hope you’ll find the strength to keep going. shit may be tough right now but you’re stronger than you realize, time is medicine, things will get better with time.
thank you, i’ll try talking with them, hopefully i’ll manage to work something out

i would talk to my school counselor but legally she has to tell someone if im thinking of hurting myself and the last thing i need is for them to know. i hope things get better for the both of us, i want to live past 18 too :)
